verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Copilot is driven by natural-language instructions across many surfaces. These include chat in VS Code, JetBrains and Visual Studio, agent mode that edits workspace files, a terminal CLI with spoken prompts, @copilot mentions in PR comments, and tasks assigned to autonomous cloud agents. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands reliably drive these agentic workflows (community items mostly concern completions, not NL operation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Mention `@copilot` in a comment on an existing pull request to ask it to make changes.
As an alternative to typing, you can speak your prompt.
Copilot in your editor does it all, from explaining concepts and completing code, to proposing edits and validating files with agent mode.
Assign tasks to agents like Copilot, Claude by Anthropic, and OpenAI Codex, and let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
The command-line interface (CLI) for GitHub Copilot allows you to use Copilot directly from your terminal.
